# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Report vulnerabilities affecting the latest stable [Kicker release](https://github.com/lechixy/Kicker/releases/latest). Reports about current prereleases are welcome. If you found an issue on an older version, include that version and say whether it also affects the latest release if you have checked.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/lechixy/Kicker/security/advisories/new) when it is available. If you cannot access the form, open an [issue](https://github.com/lechixy/Kicker/issues/new/choose) asking the maintainers for a private contact channel. Keep details of the vulnerability out of public issues, comments, and pull requests.

In your private report, include the Kicker version and installation source, Android version, affected feature, and potential impact. Describe what you observed and include relevant logs or screenshots with credentials, session cookies, tokens, and personal data removed.

Give maintainers time to investigate and coordinate disclosure before sharing details publicly. For issues with Kick's own service or account security, contact [Kick Support](https://help.kick.com/).
